observations: Photo 0: A truck chassis with 'MACK' visible on the grille, carrying a yellow crane superstructure marked 'PPM'. Large truck tires lie detached on the ground nearby.
Photo 1: Close-up of the crane boom showing painted text 'Crane CAPACITY 50T' and 'S.W.L 25T', with a hydraulic cylinder and pivot visible, some rust and wear on the metal.
Photo 2: A separate yellow wheel loader/backhoe-type machine with a front bucket, parked in a dirt yard, cab windows appear broken or missing glass.
Background in all photos shows a residential compound with concrete block walls, banana plants, and a building with AC units - consistent with a Nigerian compound, not a dedicated industrial yard.
No generators, no dredging pipes, and no 'workshop' structure are visible in any of the three photos.

read_from: photo 0 (PPM lettering on crane body, MACK on truck grille)

claims.evidence: No generator is visible in any of the 3 photos; only a crane truck and a wheel loader are shown.

claims.claim: Item list: '42 pieces of dredging pipes'
claims.evidence: No pipes of any kind are visible in photo 0, 1, or 2.

claims.claim: Item list: '2 Two standing workshop all with...'
claims.evidence: No workshop structure or related equipment is shown; only a crane and a loader appear.

claims.claim: Crane capacity 50T (S.W.L 25T) as painted on boom
claims.evidence: Text is painted on the machine in photo 1, but painted capacity ratings cannot be confirmed as accurate without a manufacturer plate or load test record.

risks.risk: Seller's written item list (generators, dredging pipes, workshop) does not match any item in the photos, raising doubt about what is actually being sold or whether photos/listing were mixed up or copied from elsewhere.
risks.proof: A fresh, unedited photo set showing the actual generators, pipes, and workshop structures claimed in the text, in the same location/background as the crane and loader photos.
risks.if_unproven: treat listing as unverifiable for the stated items; only the crane and loader visible in photos can be considered, and only at worst-case non-working condition

risks.risk: Mechanical/engine condition of the crane truck and loader is unknown; could be non-functional, missing engine parts, or have no battery/hydraulics working
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting, crane boom being raised/lowered, and loader bucket moving under its own hydraulic power

risks.risk: Tires on the ground near the crane in photo 0 suggest wheels/tires may be removed or damaged, not just stored
risks.proof: Close-up photo of all wheel hubs/axles on the crane showing tires properly mounted and inflated
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing/damaged tires needing replacement

risks.risk: Crane boom shows rust and wear (photo 1); structural integrity for rated 50T/25T lifting capacity cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Close-up photos of weld points, pins, and manufacturer's data/certification plate, plus any recent inspection certificate
risks.if_unproven: priced as scrap/non-certified lifting equipment, not as a rated working crane

risks.risk: Loader's cab glass appears broken or missing (photo 2), and overall machine condition (hydraulics, bucket teeth, undercarriage) is unclear
risks.proof: Photos of cab interior, hydraulic hoses, and a video of the bucket lifting/digging

risks.risk: No ownership, registration, or import/customs documents shown for heavy equipment, which is often required for resale of such machinery in Nigeria
risks.proof: Photo of title/ownership documents, customs papers, or government registration for the crane and loader
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverifiable ownership, added legal/resale risk

proof_requests: Photos of the actual generators, dredging pipes, and workshop items described in the text listing
Video of the crane truck engine starting and the boom operating
Video of the wheel loader engine starting and bucket/arm moving
Close-up photos of the crane's manufacturer data plate and any load certification
Photos of ownership/registration documents for both machines
Close-up photos of all tires properly mounted on the crane truck
response.reason: The seller's text describes generators, dredging pipes, and a workshop, but none of these appear in any of the three photos, which instead show an unrelated truck-mounted crane and a wheel loader; this mismatch between words and visual evidence is a strong red flag that the listing is mixed up, copied, or deceptive.
